description:
【Excellent Performance】The mountain bike features a sturdy carbon steel frame and advanced welding technology, making it a model that combines supreme durability with lightweight design. It is suitable for riders with heights ranging from 5'3″-6'0″. The maximum load capacity can reach 300 pounds.

【7-speed Transmission】This mountain bike is equipped with a 7-speed transmission system, which can easily handle undulating terrains, conquer steep slopes or accelerate on flat roads. The Outroad mountain bike is highly suitable for various environments such as mountains, wilderness, trails, cities, beaches, and snowy areas.

【Excellent Grip】Equipped with V-type brakes and durable tires that firmly adhere to the ground, it provides excellent grip even on slippery or uneven surfaces, effectively reducing the risk of skidding and enhancing riding safety.

【Customized Comfort】Adjustable handlebars and ergonomic seats provide an ideal riding position for riders with heights ranging from 5'3″-6'0″.

【Quick Assembly】It only takes 20 minutes to be ready for use - 90% of our bikes are pre-assembled, and the installation guide video makes the process easy and simple.

Specification: Wheelset: 26 inches, Frame: Carbon steel, Braking system: Calipers, Shifting system: Power 7-speed lever shifters, Rider height: 5.2'-6.2', Maximum rider weight: 300 pounds, Note: Rough handling may cause damage to the product. Please confirm the packaging is intact before receiving the item. If the packaging is damaged, there is no need to worry. Please send photos and videos to our customer service team, and we will process a full refund or replace the product with a new one for you.
